correctness.rationale: PBW basis x^iy^j (0≤i,j≤2) gives dim A=9 and dim J=8. Multiplication coefficient λ^{jr} independently reconstructs w³=s[a²b x²y + ab² xy² + {t(a²e+b²c)+(1+λ)abd}x²y²], w⁴=su a²b² x²y², and w⁵=0 for arbitrary λ, where s=1+λ+λ², t=1−λ+λ², u=1+λ². Independently expanded these in symbolic characteristic-zero polynomial arithmetic, then reduced identities to all finite fields. For w²=0 the independent degree-two a²,b² terms force a=b=0 and the remaining nondegenerate d²/ce equation has exactly q² triples (c,d,e), giving C₂=q⁵. For w³=0, s=0 gives all q⁸, else ab=0 and the t-dependent condition gives C₃ as written; w⁴=0 either all or ab=0. Nested counts yield N1..N5 and establish index-four iff st≠0 and index-five iff su≠0. The t=0,s≠0 boundary has no index four yet q⁶(q−1)² index-five elements. No use of finite search for universal quantifiers.
